Kotlin Multiplatform native D-Bus project. `src/commonMain/kotlin`: shared API/serialization; `src/nativeMain/kotlin` + `src/nativeInterop/cinterop`: Linux/native C interop; `src/nativeTest/kotlin/{unit,integration,mocks}`: tests/fixtures. `codegen/`: JVM XML-to-Kotlin CLI/library; `plugin/`: `com.monkopedia.sdbus.plugin` Gradle plugin over `:codegen`; `compile_test/`: compile-time dependency wiring; `samples/bluez-scan/`: consumer.

From repo root, use Gradle wrapper:
`./gradlew build` full build; `./gradlew test` JVM/native tests; `./gradlew ktlintCheck` style; `./gradlew licenseCheck` license/required checks; `./gradlew dokkaHtml` docs to `build/dokka`; `./gradlew codegen:fatJar` release JAR. CI release/docs run `gradle publish codegen:fatJar` and `gradle dokkaHtml` on Ubuntu.

Follow `.editorconfig`: 4 spaces, LF, max line length 100. `ktlint` uses `android_studio`; classes `UpperCamelCase`, functions/properties `lowerCamelCase`; packages under `com.monkopedia.sdbus`. Keep public API changes intentional; this repo uses Kotlin binary compatibility validation (`apiValidation`).
